newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-WHALERS, FLAMES MAKE THREE-MAN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-WHALERS, FLAMES MAKE THREE-MAN TRADE.

text.p: The Hartford Whalers acquired defenceman Steve Chiasson from the Calgary Flames in exchange for left wing Hnat Domenichelli and defenceman Glen Featherstone Wednesday night in a trade between two teams fighting to make the playoffs.
The deal was announced after the Whalers blanked Calgary 2-0 at home.

Chiasson, 29, has struggled this season, but led all Calgary defencemen with 16 points on five goals and 11 assists in 47 games. He will join his third NHL team, having broken in with the Detroit Red Wings in 1986.

Domenichelli, 21, was a second-round pick in the 1994 draft but had trouble cracking the Hartford lineup. He had two goals and an assist in 13 games with the Whalers, but spent most of the season with Springfield of the American Hockey League.
He was a prolific scorer in juniors, collecting 59 goals and 89 assists in 62 games with Kamloops of the Western Hockey League in 1995-96.

Featherstone has two goals, five assists and 87 penalty minutes in 41 games. The 28-year-old defenceman is known for his physical play, accumulating 204 penalty minutes in 68 games for St Louis in 1987-88.
Featherstone broke in with the Blues in 1988 and also has played for the Boston Bruins and New York Rangers.
